text.en: 1. This Notification is the Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (Designated Operating Entities) Notification 2025.

2.—(1) The Authority designates each entity specified in the first column of Part 1 or 2 of the Schedule as a designated operating entity.
(2) The designation of an entity as a designated operating entity takes effect on the date specified for that entity in the second column of Part 1 or 2 of the Schedule, as the case may be.
